attempts.summary: Configured node1, node2, node3 as a 3-member MariaDB Galera cluster (mariadb-server 10.11.14 + galera-4 on Ubuntu 24.04). Bootstrapped node1, joined node2 and node3 via wsrep_cluster_address=gcomm://node1,node2,node3 with mariabackup SST over a generated sstuser credential. Verified writes from any member propagate to the others, verified the cluster stayed available (Primary, quorum of 2/3) and writable while node2 was stopped, and verified node2 auto-resynchronized (IST) back to full 3/3 Synced state with no data loss on restart. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes: captured pre-restart boot_id and cluster health, issued systemctl reboot with a returning acknowledgement, polled until reachable, confirmed a new boot_id on each node, and confirmed each rejoined the cluster (size 3, Primary, Synced) with all 5 rows intact before moving to the next node.
